name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Buffers early jump presses until the first valid physics tick.

buffer-enabled.name: Enable Predictive Input Buffer
buffer-enabled.description: Hold early jump presses until the first valid tick.

toggle-keybind.name: Toggle Input Buffer
toggle-keybind.description: Toggle the buffer on or off.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer Window
buffer-ticks.description: Maximum number of physics ticks an early press may wait.

buffer-releases.name: Buffer Releases
buffer-releases.description: Preserve release timing while a press is waiting, and defer same-step releases by one tick.

debug-toasts.name: Debug Toasts
debug-toasts.description: Show a notification for each buffered, fired, dropped, or passed-through jump.
